scripts.build:shared: npm exec --workspace=@mspi/shared-db -- tsc && npm exec --workspace=@mspi/shared-auth -- tsc && echo 'SHARED_BUILD_COMPLETE'
scripts.build:tool-backends: npm exec --workspace=@mspi/pcount-backend -- tsc && npm exec --workspace=@mspi/rfpu-backend -- tsc && echo 'TOOL_BACKENDS_BUILD_COMPLETE'
scripts.build:frontends: npm exec --workspace=@mspi/pcount-frontend -- tsc -b && npm exec --workspace=@mspi/pcount-frontend -- vite build && npm exec --workspace=@mspi/rfpu-frontend -- tsc -b && npm exec --workspace=@mspi/rfpu-frontend -- vite build && npm exec --workspace=@mspi/launcher-frontend -- tsc -b && npm exec --workspace=@mspi/launcher-frontend -- vite build && echo 'FRONTENDS_BUILD_COMPLETE'
scripts.build:assemble: node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/package.json',JSON.stringify({scripts:{start:'node index.js'},main:'index.js'},null,2)+'\n')" && mkdir -p dist/public/pcount && rm -rf dist/public/pcount/* && cp -r apps/pcount/frontend/dist/. dist/public/pcount/ && mkdir -p dist/public/rfpu && rm -rf dist/public/rfpu/* && cp -r apps/rfpu/frontend/dist/. dist/public/rfpu/ && cp -r apps/launcher/frontend/dist/. dist/public/ && echo 'ASSEMBLE_COMPLETE'
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:tool-backends && npm run build:frontends && npm run build:gateway && npm run build:assemble
